subject: maths
question: How long (in years) will it take a sum of money invested at 8% per annum on simple interest to increase its value by 40%?
solution:
**Given:**

Annual interest rate (R) = 8%

Increase in value = 40%

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

Where:

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest

T = Time in years
